name: Schema Registry API
title: Schema Registry API
summary: Use the Schema Registry API to retrieve Avro schemas generated by Stream Connect, along with their subject and version history.
overview:
This API is a ServiceNow implementation of the Schema Registry API for Confluent Platform. Avro schemas are generated by Stream Connect for tables published to Kafka. This API is read-only; schemas and their evolution history are generated and maintained internally by Stream Connect.

This API requires the ServiceNow IntegrationHub Stream Connect Schema plugin (com.glide.hub.stream_connect.schema). This plugin provides the following tables:
  • Table Message Schema [sys_table_message_schema]: Stores each generated Avro schema.
  • Table Message Schema Evolution [sys_table_message_schema_evolution]: Tracks the subject and version for each schema. Schema subjects correspond to a table's Stream Connect topic name.

The calling user must have the message_schema_viewer role.

members.name: GET /schemas
members.summary: Retrieves all schemas. Optional query parameters can be used for filtering and pagination.
members.html:
URL format

Default URL: /api/now/schemaregistry/schemas

Supported request parameters

Path parameters
NameDescription
None
Query parameters
NameDescription
latestOnlyFlag that indicates whether to return all schema versions for each subject in the response.
Valid values:
  • true: Returns only the latest schema versions for each subject in the response.
  • false: Returns all schema versions for each subject in the response.

Default: false

Data type: Boolean

limitMaximum number of records to return. For requests that exceed this number of records, use the offset parameter to paginate record retrieval.

Default: 10,000

Data type: Number

offsetStarting index at which to begin retrieving records. Use this value to paginate record retrieval. This functionality enables the retrieval of all records, regardless of the number of records, in small manageable chunks.

Default: 0

Data type: Number

subjectPrefixRestrict results to subject names starting with this string.

Default: No filtering on subject names.

Data type: String

Request body parameters
NameDescription
None

Headers

The following request and response headers apply to this HTTP action only, or apply to this action in a distinct way. For a list of general headers used in the REST API, see Supported REST API headers.

Request headers
HeaderDescription
AcceptData format of the response body. Supported types: application/vnd.schemaregistry.v1+json, application/vnd.schemaregistry+json, and application/json.

Default: application/json

Response headers
HeaderDescription
None

Status codes

The following status codes apply to this HTTP action. For a list of possible status codes used in the REST API, see REST API HTTP response codes.

Status codes
Status code Description
200 Successful. The request was successfully processed.
403 Forbidden. The user doesn't have access rights to the specified record.
500 Internal server error. An unexpected error occurred while processing the request. The response contains additional information about the error.

Response body parameters (JSON)

NameDescription
deletedFlag that indicates whether the schema entry is marked as deleted.
Valid values:
  • true: The schema entry is marked as deleted.
  • false: The schema entry isn't marked as deleted.

Data type: Boolean

guidGlobally unique identifier of the schema in the format <subject>:<version>.

Data type: String

idThe numeric schema ID.

Data type: Number

schemaThe Avro schema definition as a JSON-encoded string.

Data type: String

schemaTypeThe schema format (Avro).

Data type: String

subjectThe subject name, corresponding to the table's Stream Connect topic.

Data type: String

tsThe creation timestamp for the schema record in epoch milliseconds.

Data type: Number

versionThe version number for the schema under this subject.

Data type: Number

cURL request

This example retrieves every registered schema entry.

curl -s "https://instance.servicenow.com/api/now/schemaregistry/schemas" \
  --request GET \
  --header "Accept:application/vnd.schemaregistry.v1+json" \
  --user 'username':'password'

Response body.

[

    "subject": "sn_incident",
    "version": 1,
    "id": 1879111090,
    "guid": "sn_incident:1",
    "schemaType": "AVRO",
    "schema": "{\"type\":\"record\",\"name\":\"stream_producer_table\", ... }",
    "ts": 1781633080000,
    "deleted": false
  },
  {
    "subject": "sn_incident",
    "version": 2,
    "id": 344617968,
    "guid": "sn_incident:2",
    "schemaType": "AVRO",
    "schema": "{\"type\":\"record\",\"name\":\"stream_producer_table\", ... }",
    "ts": 1782071298000,
    "deleted": false
  }
]

members.name: GET /schemas/ids/{id}/versions
members.summary: Retrieves all subject-version pairs associated with a specified schema ID.
members.html:
A schema can have multiple versions and be associated with multiple subjects. This endpoint returns every subject-version pair associated with the schema ID as a JSON array, ordered by subject and then by version.

URL format

Default URL: /api/now/schemaregistry/schemas/ids/{id}/versions

Supported request parameters

Path parameters
Name Description
id Numeric schema ID.

Table: Table Message Schema [sys_table_message_schema]

Field: Schema ID

Data type: Number
Query parameters
NameDescription
subject Scopes the schema lookup to the specified subject context. Returns only versions for the specified subject.

Default: No filtering on subject. Returns all subject-version pairs associated with a specified schema ID.

Data type: String
Request body parameters
NameDescription
None

Headers

The following request and response headers apply to this HTTP action only, or apply to this action in a distinct way. For a list of general headers used in the REST API, see Supported REST API headers.

Request headers
Header Description
Accept Data format of the response body. Supported types: application/vnd.schemaregistry.v1+json, application/vnd.schemaregistry+json, and application/json.

Default: application/json
Response headers
Header Description
None

Status codes

The following status codes apply to this HTTP action. For a list of possible status codes used in the REST API, see REST API HTTP response codes.

Status codes
Status code Description
200 Successful. The request was successfully processed.
403 Forbidden. The user doesn't have access rights to the specified record.
404 Not found. The requested item wasn't found.
500 Internal server error. An unexpected error occurred while processing the request. The response contains additional information about the error.

Response body parameters (JSON)

The response is a JSON array. Each element is an object with these fields, listed alphabetically:

NameDescription
Array JSON array of objects, each containing a subject-version pair.
<Array>.subjectThe subject name.

Data type: String

<Array>.versionThe version number for the schema registered under this subject.

Data type: Number

cURL request

This example retrieves all subject-version pairs for schema 1879111090.

curl -s "https://instance.servicenow.com/api/now/schemaregistry/schemas/ids/1879111090/versions" \
  --request GET \
  --header "Accept:application/vnd.schemaregistry.v1+json" \
  --user 'username':'password'

Response body.

[
  {
    "subject": "sn_incident",
    "version": 1
  }
]
